about.title: OCEANIC: Customs, Logistics & Transit
about.intro: OCEANIC is a leading provider of customs clearance, maritime logistics, and legal advisory services in Algeria, delivering integrated solutions that elevate institutional performance and compliance.

conseil.title: Oceanic conseil
conseil.desc: Auditing and optimizing customs processing lead-times and transport costs, dispute mediation, and proactive legal intelligence.

formation.title: Oceanic formation
formation.desc: Specialized vocational programs designed to equip professionals with actionable best practices across customs, logistics, and freight operations.

veille.title: Oceanic veille juridique
veille.desc: Direct access to vital legislative, regulatory, and judicial archives (international conventions, decrees, circulars, case law, and advisories).
